key.name: pos-x
key.description: Last horizontal position in pixels. -1 means "not set yet; use the initial corner".

key.name: pos-y
key.description: Last vertical position in pixels. -1 means "not set yet; use the initial corner".

key.name: dog-size
key.description: On-screen size of the dog in pixels.

key.name: enable-animations
key.description: Master switch for all idle and reaction animations. When off, the dog is a still image.

key.name: idle-breathing
key.description: Subtle up-and-down breathing motion while the dog is idle.

key.name: enable-sound
key.description: Play a short sound on interactions (requires GSound; silent if unavailable).

key.name: initial-position
key.description: Where the dog appears on first run and after "Reset position".

key.name: animation-frequency
key.description: How often idle blinks and tail wags happen (0 = rarely, 100 = often).

key.name: show-dog
key.description: Whether the dog is visible on the desktop.

key.name: is-sleeping
key.description: Remembers whether the dog was asleep across restarts.

key.name: reset-position
key.description: Set to true by preferences to ask the running extension to move the dog back to its initial corner. The extension sets it back to false.
